description: This file contains JavaScript functions implementing drag-and-drop functionality for portlet management within the MyPortal section of an Apache OFBiz framework-based web application. It handles sortable list initialization, order change preparation, AJAX updates to the server, and visual loading indicators.

methods.name: preparePortletBackgroundOrderChange
methods.description: Prepares and processes the change in portlet order after a drag-and-drop action, determining the new position and triggering server update.

methods.name: updatePortletOrder
methods.description: Sends an AJAX POST request to update portlet order on the server, including details of the moved element and its new position.

methods.name: onCompleteRequest
methods.description: Removes the loading indicator after an AJAX call completes.

methods.name: getDocHeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the height of the entire document, used for setting the overlay height during loading.

methods.name: onStartRequest
methods.description: Displays a loading overlay while an AJAX request is in progress.
